# Rezolute to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 02, 2026 7:30 am EST[Download as PDF](https://ir.rezolutebio.com/_assets/_1df81096bcb150a1041a3318b2f08e55/rezolutebio/news/2026-11-02_Rezolute_to_Participate_in_Upcoming_Investor_387.pdf)


REDWOOD CITY, Calif., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- **Rezolute, Inc. (Nasdaq: RZLT)** (Rezolute or Company), a late-stage ultra-rare, metabolic disease company focused on treating refractory hypoglycemia caused by any form of hyperinsulinism (HI), today announced that management will participate in the following investor conferences:


**Event** : Guggenheim 3rd Annual Healthcare Innovation Conference
**Date** : November 9-11, 2026
**Fireside Date/Time:** Monday, November 9th at 9:00am ET


**Event** : Jefferies London Healthcare Conference
**Date** : November 16-19, 2026
**Fireside Date/Time:** Thursday, November 19th at 1:00pm GMT


Management will be participating in one-on-one investor meetings throughout the conferences. Investors interested in scheduling a meeting with the Rezolute management team should contact their Guggenheim and Jefferies representatives.


**About Rezolute, Inc.**


Rezolute is a late-stage ultra-rare, metabolic disease company focused on treating refractory hypoglycemia caused by any form of hyperinsulinism (HI). The Company’s antibody therapy, ersodetug, has been studied in clinical trials and used in real-world cases for the treatment of refractory hypoglycemia due to a variety of causes of HI. For more information, visit[www.rezolutebio.com](http://www.rezolutebio.com/) .
